newEntry.name: Caliper & Slide
newEntry.desc: Snip twelve runners, flip a tongue-bearing jaw and bond its underside keeper for a captive vernier teaching gauge. Measured sheet/socket reference, adjustable pitch, reach and calibrated gaps; local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL wing grips, connected-card and three-part STL/ZIP. Adhesive required; educational, not a calibrated instrument.
